_about: Polygons the original draws wrong in a way its artists plainly did not intend: an authored draw priority that ties a coplanar layer drawn after it, which the original z-fights on, or UVs that break a texture across a seam. Each entry patches one polygon (its index in the node's mesh) in both graphics modes; the texture guards against patching a different install. 'planes' is planes.zbd.

planes._why: Devastator lower left wing, top: the outer panel's root corners (vertices 73, 80) take the inner panel's UVs there (poly 4), as the right wing's do, so the white line runs on (#318)
